thread:
incident-bot: PD alert fired for route=\"inference-eu\", incident=PD-87431, severity=P1. Alert: spike in request latency across eu-west1. No 5xx detected. Paging oncall.

alice (oncall): ack. I'm taking first touch, will snapshot dashboards and correlation logs.

bob: grabbing perf graphs now — p50 ~1.1s, p95 ~4.4s, queue depth on embedder-pool up ~3x baseline. No obvious errors in logs yet.

carol: I'll take ownership for mitigation. @alice handing to me, please forward customer comms if they ping. Starting with autoscaler and worker health checks.

alice (oncall): handing to @carol. I'm available for client updates. :thumbsup:

carol: running quick checks:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=model-worker -o wide
kubectl top pods -n inference | sort -r -k3 | head
curl -s https://console.redwood/metrics?range=15m&query=embedder_queue_depth
```
Seeing 2 workers at 100% CPU and high RPS on small-quant models. HPA target seems stuck.

bob: confirmed HPA for embedder-pool hasn't scaled in last 18m, CPU metrics delayed. Could be metrics-agent backlog.

carol: immediate mitigation: triggering manual scale to add 4 pods, and rolling restart of model-worker-3 to flush stale caches. Executing now.

incident-bot: Action recorded: manual-scale embedder-pool -> +4 pods (operator=carol).

carol: manual scale done. Rolling restart triggered. Monitoring latency. ETA 2-4m to see effect. :eyes:

dave: any customer-visible errors? Support hasn't seen 500s, but a handful of interactive sessions reported lag. Tracking customer list now.

bob: no 5xx, just elevated tail latency and some client retries. We've flagged customers with high RPS in eu-west1: cust-phi, cust-beta. Notifying account teams.

alice (oncall): posting interim update to oncall channel and Slack #customers: \"Investigation in progress, manual scaling applied, mitigating now. No data loss.\"

carol: latency trends starting to improve — p95 down from 4.4s to ~1.2s over last 3m. Queue depth trending down. Keeping scaling in place for 10m.

eve (product): thanks — any preliminary RCA?

carol: preliminary: metrics-agent backlog prevented HPA from seeing recent CPU rise; autoscaler didn't trigger. Likely a short-term metrics ingestion hiccup. We'll open follow-up.

bob: filing INC-4567 to track root cause & long-term fix (metrics ingestion alerting + autoscaler fallback).

incident-bot: Note added to PD-87431: mitigation applied (manual-scale + restart), latency improving, monitoring.

carol: closing PD page now and will keep an eye for 10m before full closure.

alice (oncall): marking as resolved in Slack: \"Mitigated — manual scale + restart; tail latency returned to baseline; no 5xx; follow-up ticket INC-4567 created.\" :white_check_mark:

dave: pinging account managers for cust-phi and cust-beta with impact window ~12m and summary.

carol: final note: we should add HPA healthcheck on metrics-agent lag and a fallback that can scale based on request queue length. I'll add to INC-4567.

alice (oncall): thanks team. Roundtrip total ~22m from page to mitigation. Closing thread.
